text:
Type: tall cabinet with glass and panel doors
Use: displaying tableware, books or collections, closed storage below; dining room, living room, home office
Style: traditional, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: solid wood in a white stain with visible grain, clear glass upper panes, black knobs
Colors: soft white, black knobs
Shape: tall upright cabinet with two doors, glass in the upper part and recessed panels below, glass shelves, simple molded top, straight legs, stately
Feel: fresh, homely, bright, timeless
Goes with: light wood, white walls, blue or grey tones, linen; farmhouse, traditional or Scandinavian dining rooms
